actualContext: System instructions specifying assistant and tools

actualTools.operation: One exact cat read of the five permitted packet files

design.organization: Four directly implemented exported functions, no private helper or added async wrapper
design.correspondence: Retains conventional TypeScript idioms and strong contract-expression correspondence; not a claim of absolute clean-room independence
design.declarations: Exact supplied API parameter shapes and inline import types, without new aliases
design.stateOwner: Supplied runtime and imported dependencies remain the owners of state and execution policy
design.semantics: Native async functions, await locations, callee receivers, ordered field evaluation, lazy request callback, optional logger argument evaluation, and supplied reference identities follow the body-free contract

limits: No production, history, tests, oracle, lineage, dependency bodies, other packets, or team status were read
No candidate execution, compile, test, provider/model/MCP/network invocation, or task tool was used
No userdata, credential, OS/settings, permission, execution-state, policy, cache, retry, listener, or deadline effects were introduced
No checkout edits; only named own temporary outputs written
Source is below the supplied 400-physical-line limit by construction
No runtime or type-check validation performed under the author boundary
No contribution percentage or licence/header claim
sealOrdering: SHA256 hashes taken after draft and access writes and before parent/curator comparison; seal.json records those exact hashes
